title.zh: 稀疏集合效应更新回收器

problem.zh: 顺序部署的旧更新可能只在与其他更新联合存在时变得冗余或有害，因此逐个删除测试会漏掉可联合回收的更新集合，也可能误删具有协同作用的更新。
problem.en: Sequentially deployed updates can become redundant or harmful only in combination with other updates, so one-at-a-time deletion tests miss jointly removable sets and can incorrectly delete synergistic updates.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设每个更新的删除效应可由独立边际贡献判断，而是假设少量更新之间存在稀疏的高阶交互，并且这种集合效应可由有限禁用干预学习后迁移到未来版本。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of assuming deletion effects are determined by independent marginal contributions, assume sparse higher-order interactions among updates can be learned from a limited intervention budget and transferred to future versions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 将每个版本的更新注册表表示为带更新描述符的节点集合。训练阶段在预算内随机执行单点和小集合 disable interventions，记录能力向量与回归向量的变化，并拟合一个稀疏 set-effect 模型：主效应预测单更新贡献，低阶超边预测只有联合禁用时才出现的互补或冗余效应。模型随后在训练版本结束时冻结，通过受约束集合优化一次性预测最大可删除集合，使预测能力损失低于阈值且预期回归风险不升高。候选集合最后仅经过独立安全证书门控；证书不参与模型学习。未来版本只允许使用冻结的 set-effect 模型和新更新的可观测描述符产生删除集合，不重新拟合。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent each versioned update registry as a set of nodes with update descriptors. During training, spend a fixed budget on randomized singleton and small-set disable interventions, record changes in capability and regression vectors, and fit a sparse set-effect model whose main effects capture individual contributions and whose low-order hyperedges capture complementarity or redundancy visible only under joint disabling. Freeze the model at the end of training and solve a constrained set-selection problem that predicts the largest deletion set whose predicted capability loss stays below threshold without increasing expected regression risk. The predicted set is then passed through an independent safety certificate that does not contribute learning signal. On future versions, deletion sets must be produced only by the frozen model from observable descriptors of the accumulated updates, without refitting.

children.update_surface: frozen sparse update-interaction hypergraph with versioned deletion-set policy

learning_signal.zh: 预算化随机 disable interventions 下，单更新或更新集合被关闭前后的能力差、回归差和交互残差；训练目标同时拟合集合效应并施加超边稀疏正则。
learning_signal.en: Capability deltas, regression deltas, and interaction residuals measured before and after budgeted randomized singleton or set disable interventions, with a training objective that fits set effects under hyperedge sparsity regularization.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 在训练结束后才生成的未来版本上，对冻结模型预测的删除集合执行真实联合禁用，并用未参与训练的能力测试、回归测试和完全穷举或高预算子集搜索得到的近似 oracle 删除集合评估预测质量。
independent_ground_truth.en: On future versions created only after training, execute the frozen model's predicted joint deletions and evaluate them using capability and regression tests never used for fitting, together with exhaustive or high-budget subset search that provides an approximate oracle deletion set.

simplest_baseline.zh: 相同总干预预算下的 greedy leave-one-update-out：逐个测试每个更新，删除单独移除时无可测性能下降的更新，并在验证失败时恢复。
simplest_baseline.en: Greedy leave-one-update-out under the identical total intervention budget: test updates individually, delete each update whose isolated removal causes no measurable degradation, and restore it when validation fails.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造或采集包含 12–20 个顺序更新的版本链，其中预注册一类关键情形：两个或三个更新单独删除均有损，但联合删除无损，或单独看均中性但联合删除有害。只在前半版本拟合模型并冻结，在后半未见版本上给予所有方法完全相同的 24 次 disable 评估预算。主要指标是 oracle 可安全删除集合的 set-F1、实际回收更新数和删除后的独立能力损失。只有当冻结超图模型在不提高回归率的前提下，以显著更高的 set-F1 或更多安全回收量超过 greedy leave-one-out，才支持新机制。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct or collect version chains containing 12–20 sequential updates with a preregistered critical case: pairs or triples whose members appear necessary individually but are jointly removable, or appear neutral individually but are harmful when removed together. Fit and freeze the model on early versions only, then give every method exactly 24 disable evaluations on unseen later versions. Primary outcomes are set-F1 against the oracle safe-deletion set, number of updates safely reclaimed, and independent post-deletion capability loss. The mechanism survives only if the frozen hypergraph achieves materially higher set-F1 or safe reclamation than greedy leave-one-out without increasing regression rate.

stop_condition.zh: 若在至少两个未来版本链和三个随机种子上，交互模型在相同干预算下不能比 greedy leave-one-out 提高安全删除集合 set-F1，或优势在移除显式二阶/三阶交互项后不下降，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, across at least two future-version chains and three seeds, the interaction model does not improve safe-deletion set-F1 over greedy leave-one-out under the same intervention budget, or if removing explicit second-/third-order interaction terms does not reduce the advantage.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的真实问题、预算化 disable intervention、版本化更新注册表以及最终安全删除证书。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's real problem, budgeted disable interventions, versioned update registry, and final safe-deletion certificate.

material_change.zh: 核心学习对象从逐更新边际贡献变为可冻结、可迁移的稀疏集合效应超图；算法直接预测联合删除集合，决定性实验专门测试 greedy 单更新消融无法识别的交互删除结构。
material_change.en: The learned object changes from per-update marginal utility to a frozen transferable sparse set-effect hypergraph that directly predicts joint deletion sets, with the decisive experiment targeting interaction structures that greedy singleton ablation cannot identify.

title.zh: 干预式消息效应迁移器

problem.zh: 固定或直接优化的多 Agent 通信图容易把训练任务上的边效用当成可迁移规律，在任务结构改变后继续保留干扰边或删除必要的协同边。
problem.en: Fixed or directly optimized multi-agent communication graphs can mistake training-task edge utility for transferable structure, retaining interfering edges or pruning necessary cooperative edges when task structure changes.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把最终通信图本身当作需要迁移的对象，而是假设可迁移对象是“在给定任务 motif 与邻近通信上下文下，一条边或一组边的干预效应”。
changed_assumption.en: The transferable object is no longer the final communication graph itself, but the intervention effect of an edge or small edge set conditioned on task motifs and local communication context.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先将任务表示为不包含答案的结构 motif 描述符，例如分解深度、信息源数量、顺序依赖、角色异质性和需要聚合的证据数。在训练任务上，对候选消息边执行配对干预：正常发送、mask、内容保持长度的无信息替换，以及选定二边联合 mask。利用这些反事实结果训练一个 edge-effect predictor，输入任务 motif、发送/接收角色、边位置及局部邻接上下文，输出该边存在对任务成功率、token 成本和错误传播风险的预测增量，并显式估计少量二边交互。训练后冻结预测器。面对完全未见任务，只进行一次前向预测并在固定边数/token 约束下构造图，不再用目标任务 reward 搜索拓扑。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent each task using answer-free structural motif descriptors such as decomposition depth, number of information sources, sequential dependencies, role heterogeneity, and evidence aggregation demand. On training tasks, perform paired interventions on candidate message edges: normal transmission, masking, length-matched noninformative replacement, and selected two-edge joint masks. Train an edge-effect predictor from these counterfactual outcomes. Given task motif, sender/receiver roles, graph position, and local adjacency context, it predicts the incremental effect of an edge on task success, token cost, and error-propagation risk, plus sparse pairwise interactions. Freeze the predictor after training. For a completely unseen task, construct a graph in one prediction pass under fixed edge-count and token constraints, without reward-based topology search on that target task.

learning_signal.zh: 同一任务实例和相同 Agent 输出条件下，消息边正常、mask、无信息替换及联合 mask 之间的配对成功差、错误传播差和 token 差。
learning_signal.en: Paired differences in task success, propagated error, and token usage between normal, masked, noninformatively replaced, and jointly masked message-edge interventions on matched task instances.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 训练期间从未出现的任务家族与 motif 组合；在这些任务上用额外、仅用于评测的边消融测得真实边效应，并用完整任务成功率验证冻结预测器构造的图。
independent_ground_truth.en: Task families and motif combinations never observed during fitting; evaluation-only edge interventions on those tasks provide measured edge effects, while end-task success evaluates graphs constructed by the frozen predictor.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 Adaptive-Graph-Pruning 式 task-edge score predictor：使用相同任务描述符和模型容量，但只从观察到的图性能或边使用统计学习每条边分数，不使用受控反事实干预或边交互标签。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched Adaptive-Graph-Pruning-style task-edge score predictor using the same task descriptors and model capacity, but learning edge scores only from observed graph performance or edge-use statistics, without controlled counterfactual interventions or edge-interaction labels.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择至少三个可程序化多 Agent 基准家族，训练时完整留出一个任务家族以及若干 motif 组合。所有方法共享相同候选角色、最大边数、LLM 调用、token 和训练期图评估次数。比较冻结干预预测器、容量匹配 task-edge predictor、GPTSwarm、AgentPrune 和 Adaptive Graph Pruning。主要检验不是训练任务最优图，而是未见家族上的边效应符号准确率、pairwise interaction AUROC、零目标奖励搜索条件下的任务成功率。若干预模型只能在继续搜索目标图时获胜，则不算通过。
decisive_pilot.en: Use at least three programmable multi-agent benchmark families, holding out one entire family plus selected motif combinations during training. Match candidate roles, maximum edges, LLM calls, tokens, and training-time graph evaluations across methods. Compare the frozen intervention predictor against a capacity-matched task-edge predictor, GPTSwarm, AgentPrune, and Adaptive Graph Pruning. Primary tests are edge-effect sign accuracy, pairwise-interaction AUROC, and task success on the unseen family with zero target-task reward search. An advantage that appears only after further target-graph optimization does not count.

stop_condition.zh: 若冻结干预预测器在完全未见任务家族上不能同时超过容量匹配非干预 predictor 的边效应预测和最终成功率，或关闭二边交互建模后性能不下降，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen intervention-trained predictor cannot outperform the capacity-matched noninterventional predictor on both edge-effect prediction and final success for a completely unseen task family, or if removing pairwise interaction modeling causes no degradation.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案关于通信干扰/冗余的真实问题、边 mask/替换干预以及跨未见任务冻结评测。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the real communication-interference problem, edge masking/replacement interventions, and frozen evaluation on unseen tasks.

material_change.zh: 持久对象从“被优化的通信拓扑”改成“由受控干预学习的因果边效应预测器”；测试期不再优化边，而是要求该冻结预测器零搜索地迁移到完全未见任务。
material_change.en: The persistent object changes from an optimized communication topology to a causal edge-effect predictor learned from controlled interventions; test-time edge optimization is removed and the frozen predictor must transfer zero-search to completely unseen tasks.

title.zh: 行为保持残差补丁代数

problem.zh: 新提交破坏已有 Agent 更新时，直接重新生成完整补丁容易覆盖此前已经验证正确的行为；而逐实例二次修补又难以迁移到后续提交。
problem.en: When a new commit breaks a previously deployed agent update, generating a complete replacement patch can overwrite behavior that was already verified, while per-instance second patches do not transfer reliably to later commits.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再学习“从失败到新完整补丁”的黑盒映射，而是假设修复可以表示为作用在前一更新上的局部残差算子，并且残差必须满足显式 footprint、preservation 与多轮 composition 约束。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of learning a black-box mapping from failure to a complete new patch, assume repair can be represented as a localized residual operator over the previous update, constrained by explicit footprint, preservation, and multi-round composition requirements.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先把持久更新规范化为 typed edit set：每个原子包含目标对象、位置或键、操作类型、值以及可追踪的行为契约标签。给定前一更新 U_t、失败签名 f_t 和已验证不受影响契约 C_keep，模型预测 residual R_t=(selector, edit)，其中 selector 只能选择 U_t 中至多 k 个原子或其显式依赖闭包，edit 只能修改被选原子；未选择原子在结构上保持不可写。训练损失由成功修复损失、编辑 footprint 惩罚、C_keep 上的 preservation loss 和多轮 composition consistency 构成。组合定义为 U_{t+1}=R_t∘U_t，并要求连续两个 residual 的结果与一次应用到对应局部依赖闭包的规范化组合一致。最终冻结 residual operator，在未见提交上只生成局部变换而非完整 replacement patch。
exact_mechanism.en: Canonicalize each persistent update into a typed edit set whose atoms contain target object, location or key, operation type, value, and traceable behavioral-contract tags. Given previous update U_t, failure signature f_t, and verified unaffected contracts C_keep, the model predicts a residual R_t=(selector, edit). The selector may choose at most k atoms of U_t or their explicit dependency closure, and the edit is structurally unable to modify unselected atoms. Training combines repair-success loss, edit-footprint penalty, preservation loss over C_keep, and multi-round composition consistency. Composition is defined as U_{t+1}=R_t composed with U_t, and two sequential residuals must agree with the canonical composition over their local dependency closure. Freeze the residual operator and require it to produce only localized transformations, never complete replacement patches, on unseen commits.

children.update_surface: frozen typed residual transformation over versioned agent-update edit sets

learning_signal.zh: 历史 first-update/second-patch 对中的实际修改 footprint、修复后失败契约是否恢复、此前已验证契约是否保持，以及同一修复链多轮组合后的行为一致性。
learning_signal.en: Observed modification footprints in historical first-update/second-patch pairs, recovery of the failed contract, preservation of previously verified contracts, and behavioral consistency after composing multiple repairs in the same update chain.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对未见提交使用独立隐藏契约集：一部分只检查目标失败是否被修复，另一部分专门覆盖训练时未暴露的 unaffected behavior；同时由真实 diff 判断生成 residual 是否越过预注册局部 footprint。
independent_ground_truth.en: Use independent hidden contracts on unseen commits: one subset checks whether the target failure is repaired and another covers unaffected behavior never exposed during training; actual diffs independently verify whether the generated residual exceeds the preregistered locality footprint.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同训练对、相同参数量和输入字段训练的 conditional full-patch generator，直接输出完整 replacement patch，不施加 selector、局部不可写约束、preservation loss 或 composition consistency。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched conditional full-patch generator trained on exactly the same pairs and input fields, directly producing a complete replacement patch without selectors, structural locality, preservation loss, or composition consistency.

decisive_pilot.zh: 从公开 Agent 仓库或可控 Agent 配置中构建至少 100 条三轮更新链 U0→U1→U2→U3，每轮引入一个新修复且预留上一轮已经通过的行为契约。按仓库或任务家族切分，完整留出提交链。对 residual operator、等容量 full-patch generator、nearest-patch retrieval、TPGO/GRAO 式 proposal 和 full joint re-optimization 使用相同训练样本与推理调用。主要指标为目标修复率、隐藏 unaffected-contract preservation、修改 footprint 和第三轮后的累计回归率。关键证据必须是 residual 方法在相近目标修复率下显著减少隐藏回归，并且这种优势在取消结构化 selector 或 preservation loss 后消失。
decisive_pilot.en: Build at least 100 three-round update chains U0→U1→U2→U3 from public agent repositories or controllable agent configurations, with each round introducing a new repair while retaining behavioral contracts already passed by previous rounds. Split by repository or task family and hold out entire commit chains. Match training examples and inference calls for the residual operator, capacity-matched full-patch generator, nearest-patch retrieval, TPGO/GRAO-style proposal, and full joint re-optimization. Primary metrics are target repair rate, hidden unaffected-contract preservation, edit footprint, and cumulative regression after round three. The decisive result is substantially lower hidden regression at comparable repair rate, with the advantage disappearing when the structured selector or preservation objective is removed.

stop_condition.zh: 若残差结构在未见多轮提交上不能以相近修复率降低隐藏回归，或普通 conditional generator 在加入同等 token/参数预算后达到相同 locality 与 preservation，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the residual structure does not reduce hidden regression at comparable repair rate on unseen multi-round commits, or if the ordinary conditional generator reaches the same locality and preservation under matched token and parameter budgets.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案从失败更新与成功二次补丁中学习、冻结后迁移到未见提交的核心设置。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's setting of learning from failed updates and successful second patches and transferring a frozen operator to unseen commits.

material_change.zh: 把模糊的 residual 概念变为具有明确 typed update algebra、硬局部写约束、unaffected-behavior preservation 和多轮组合定律的结构化算子，从而形成普通完整补丁生成器无法天然表达的归纳偏置。
material_change.en: The vague residual concept becomes a structured operator with an explicit typed update algebra, hard local write constraints, unaffected-behavior preservation, and multi-round composition laws, creating an inductive bias not inherent to generic complete-patch generation.

title.zh: 反事实纠错产生式语法

problem.zh: 按失败轨迹或粗粒度失败标签保存纠错技能时，Agent 在从未联合出现过的复合失败上缺少可靠的重组规则，尤其无法判断某个纠错动作究竟是必要原因修复还是偶然共现步骤。
problem.en: When correction skills are stored by failure trace or coarse failure label, agents lack reliable recombination rules for failure factors never observed together and cannot distinguish necessary corrective actions from merely co-occurring steps.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设从轨迹归纳出的 slot 与技能足以支持组合，而是假设每条可迁移产生式必须由模块替换干预识别出因果 failure slot，并由动作插入/删除反事实确认必要纠错动作及其 typed precondition/effect。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of assuming trace-induced slots and skills are sufficient for composition, require every transferable production to be grounded in a causally identified failure slot from module-replacement interventions and a necessary correction action established through action insertion/deletion counterfactuals with typed preconditions and effects.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对可分模块 Agent 建立 intervention matrix：对感知、规划、工具选择和执行模块分别以 oracle 或已验证替代模块替换，观察失败是否消失，由此将失败归因到最小 causal slot 集。随后对候选纠错动作执行两类反事实：从成功修复轨迹中删除该动作，或将该动作单独插入匹配失败轨迹；只有删除导致修复失效且插入在满足前置条件时恢复目标 effect 的动作才被编译为 necessary production。每个 production 记录 typed precondition、effect、不可共存条件和可交换条件。冻结后，解析器仅依据当前检测到的 causal slots 选择满足 precondition 的 productions，并按 effect dependencies 组合；测试阶段不允许新增 production。
exact_mechanism.en: Build an intervention matrix over modular agents by replacing perception, planning, tool-selection, and execution modules with oracle or verified substitutes and observing which failures disappear, thereby identifying the minimal causal failure-slot set. For candidate correction actions, run two counterfactual tests: delete the action from a successful repair trajectory and insert the action alone into a matched failing trajectory. Compile an action into a necessary production only if deletion destroys the repair and insertion restores the target effect when its precondition holds. Each production stores typed preconditions, effects, incompatibility constraints, and commutativity conditions. After freezing, a parser selects productions only from detected causal slots and composes them according to effect dependencies; no new production may be added at test time.

children.update_surface: frozen library of intervention-identified typed correction productions

learning_signal.zh: 模块替换前后失败状态的变化用于识别 causal slot；候选纠错动作删除与插入后的修复成败用于判定动作必要性；执行状态差用于归纳 typed precondition/effect。
learning_signal.en: Changes in failure status under module replacement identify causal slots; repair outcomes under candidate-action deletion and insertion establish action necessity; execution-state differences induce typed preconditions and effects.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 通过程序化或人工可验证任务生成 factorial failure grid，并完整留出若干从未共同出现的 failure-factor 组合；每个 slot 的真实来源由可控故障注入记录，每个动作 effect 由环境状态转移而非语言模型自评判定。
independent_ground_truth.en: Generate a factorial failure grid using programmable or human-verifiable tasks and hold out combinations of failure factors never jointly observed during training. True slot origins come from controlled fault-injection records, and action effects are determined by environment state transitions rather than model self-judgment.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同诱导 slot 标签，每个 slot 保存一个验证过的纠错技能，再由 NSI/SkillGraph 式 dependency composer 在测试时组合，不做动作必要性的删除/插入反事实，也不学习 causal production precondition/effect。
simplest_baseline.en: Using exactly the same induced slot labels, store one verified correction skill per slot and compose them at test time with an NSI/SkillGraph-style dependency composer, without action-necessity deletion/insertion counterfactuals or causal production precondition/effect induction.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择一个可控工具 Agent 环境，注入四类 failure factors，每类至少两个取值，形成 factorial grid；训练只观察单因子和部分双因子组合，完整留出至少 25% 的双因子/三因子组合。所有方法使用同样 slot classifier、同样训练轨迹、同样测试调用数。比较因果产生式语法、NSI/SkillGraph composer、slot-conditioned retrieval。主要指标为未见组合上的成功率、错误纠错动作率和因 precondition 冲突造成的失败率。必须出现这样的差异：即使 baseline 拿到完全相同的 slot 标签，因果 production 仍能在未见组合上更正确地选择、排序或抑制动作。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a controllable tool-agent environment with four failure-factor types and at least two values per factor, forming a factorial grid. Training observes only single-factor and selected pairwise combinations, while at least 25% of pairwise/triple combinations are held out entirely. All methods receive the same slot classifier, training traces, and test-time call budget. Compare the causal production grammar against an NSI/SkillGraph composer and slot-conditioned retrieval. Primary outcomes are success on unseen combinations, incorrect-correction rate, and failures caused by precondition conflicts. The required effect is that, despite receiving identical slot labels, the causal productions choose, order, or suppress actions more correctly on unseen compositions.

stop_condition.zh: 若使用相同 slot 标签的现有程序/技能组合器在未见 factorial 组合上达到等价成功率与错误动作率，或去掉动作删除/插入反事实后结果不下降，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if an existing program/skill composer with the same slot labels matches success and incorrect-action rates on unseen factorial combinations, or if removing action deletion/insertion counterfactuals does not degrade results.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的感知/规划/工具/执行 failure slots、持久纠错表示以及冻结后跨未见失败组合重组的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's perception/planning/tool/execution failure slots, persistent correction representation, and goal of frozen recombination over unseen failure compositions.

material_change.zh: 创新中心从通用 grammar composition 转移到两个可检验的因果识别步骤：模块替换识别 failure slot，以及动作删除/插入识别 necessary correction；语法只作为这些因果产生式的执行载体。
material_change.en: The scientific center moves from generic grammar composition to two testable causal-identification steps: module replacement for failure slots and action deletion/insertion for necessary corrections. The grammar becomes only the execution substrate for those causally grounded productions.

title.zh: 潜在效应跨表面转译器

problem.zh: 部署环境可能禁止原修复所在的 Prompt、记忆、技能或工作流表面，因此系统需要把已经有效的持久修复迁移到另一种更新表面，同时保持原修复效果并避免新回归。
problem.en: A deployment may forbid the prompt, memory, skill, or workflow surface where a successful repair was originally stored, requiring the persistent repair to move to another surface while preserving its effect and avoiding new regressions.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再直接学习 source asset 到 target asset 的表面重写，而是假设不同更新表面共享一个可学习的 surface-invariant behavioral effect space；转译需要先恢复 effect，再由目标表面条件化 decoder 实现该 effect。
changed_assumption.en: Instead of directly learning source-asset to target-asset rewriting, assume different adaptation surfaces share a learnable surface-invariant behavioral-effect space; translation must first recover the effect and then realize it through a target-surface-conditioned decoder.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对训练期已有的行为等价跨表面修复组，分别执行一组训练 behavioral probes，得到每个修复的 effect signature：包括目标行为变化、受保护行为变化和触发条件变化。训练 source encoder 将任意表面资产及其训练 probe signature 映射到潜变量 z_effect；使用跨表面对比/循环一致性，使行为等价的不同表面修复共享 z_effect，同时分离表面格式特征。每个目标表面共享一个 typed effect-to-update decoder，其输入仅为 z_effect、目标表面 schema 和容量约束。训练结束后冻结 encoder/decoder。评测时完整留出有向 surface pair A→B；给定 A 上的源修复，不提供任何 A→B 示例，只通过冻结 encoder 得到 z_effect，再生成 B 资产。评测使用从未参与训练或选择的 hidden contracts。
exact_mechanism.en: For behavior-equivalent cross-surface repair groups available during training, execute a training suite of behavioral probes to obtain an effect signature covering target-behavior changes, protected-behavior changes, and triggering-condition changes. Train a source encoder to map an asset from any surface plus its training probe signature into a latent z_effect. Cross-surface contrastive and cycle-consistency objectives force behavior-equivalent repairs from different surfaces to share z_effect while separating surface-format features. A typed effect-to-update decoder for each target surface receives only z_effect, the target schema, and capacity constraints. Freeze all encoders and decoders after training. At evaluation, hold out an entire directed surface pair A→B; given a repair on A, provide no A→B exemplars and generate the B asset only through the frozen effect representation. Evaluation uses hidden contracts never used for fitting or model selection.

children.update_surface: frozen surface-invariant behavioral-effect encoder and typed target-surface decoders

learning_signal.zh: 训练 behavioral probes 上的目标效应向量与回归效应向量、跨表面已知等价组标签、潜在 effect 一致性以及 decoder 生成资产后的训练契约执行结果。
learning_signal.en: Target-effect and regression-effect vectors from training behavioral probes, known cross-surface equivalence-group labels, latent-effect consistency, and training-contract execution results of assets emitted by the decoders.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 为每个 held-out directed surface pair 预先封存一组 hidden behavioral contracts，包括目标修复行为与未受影响行为；这些 contracts 不进入 effect encoder、decoder 训练、超参选择或 early stopping。
independent_ground_truth.en: For every held-out directed surface pair, pre-seal hidden behavioral contracts covering both repaired behavior and unaffected behavior. These contracts are excluded from effect-encoder training, decoder training, hyperparameter selection, and early stopping.

simplest_baseline.zh: SkillIR 式固定 canonical IR 加手写 target emitter：源修复先映射到人工定义的统一 IR，再用每个表面的确定性适配器生成目标资产；使用完全相同的模型调用、token 和目标表面容量。
simplest_baseline.en: A SkillIR-style fixed canonical IR with hand-written target emitters: map the source repair into a manually specified common IR and use deterministic per-surface adapters to emit the target asset, under identical model calls, tokens, and target-surface capacity.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用四种表面 Prompt、memory、skill、workflow，建立至少 6 个训练有向 pair，并完整留出至少 4 个有向 pair，特别保证某个目标表面在训练中出现过但从未与该源表面配对。所有方法获得相同源修复、训练 contracts、调用与目标容量。比较 latent-effect translator、source-conditioned target rewrite、固定 IR + emitter。主要指标为 hidden contract 上目标修复通过率、protected behavior 回归率和 held-out pair 的双向 effect distance。只有当 latent-effect 方法在没有 target-pair exemplar 的情况下优于两个 baseline，且优势集中在训练中未见的有向 pair，才支持该假设。
decisive_pilot.en: Use four surfaces—prompt, memory, skill, and workflow—with at least six directed pairs for training and at least four directed pairs held out entirely. Ensure a target surface appears during training but is never paired with the held-out source surface. Give all methods the same source repair, training contracts, calls, and target capacity. Compare the latent-effect translator, source-conditioned target rewriting, and fixed IR plus emitter. Primary metrics are target-repair pass rate on hidden contracts, protected-behavior regression, and bidirectional effect distance on held-out pairs. The hypothesis survives only if the latent-effect method beats both baselines without any target-pair exemplar, with the advantage concentrated on unseen directed pairs.

stop_condition.zh: 若固定 IR + 手写 emitter 或容量匹配 source-conditioned rewrite 在完整留出的有向 surface pairs 上达到等价 hidden-contract 保真度，或 learned z_effect 不能比表面格式特征更好预测跨表面行为等价性，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if fixed IR plus hand-written emitters or a capacity-matched source-conditioned rewriter achieves equivalent hidden-contract fidelity on fully held-out directed surface pairs, or if learned z_effect does not predict cross-surface behavioral equivalence better than surface-format features.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案跨 Prompt、memory、skill、workflow 迁移持久修复以及以行为等价和回归测试验证转译的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's goal of moving persistent repairs across prompt, memory, skill, and workflow surfaces and validating translation through behavioral equivalence and regression tests.

material_change.zh: 从直接跨表面 asset rewrite 改成明确的 surface-invariant effect 表示学习，并通过完整留出有向 surface pair 与独立 hidden contracts 排除记忆 target-pair 映射；同时把最强简单方法固定为 canonical IR + hand-written emitters。
material_change.en: The method changes from direct cross-surface asset rewriting to explicit learning of a surface-invariant effect representation, with entire directed surface pairs and independent hidden contracts held out to rule out memorized target-pair mappings; the strongest simple comparator is fixed as canonical IR plus hand-written emitters.

title.zh: 反事实后代记忆变换器

problem.zh: 同一经验可能对不同任务子群产生方向相反的未来影响；仅全局保留或删除会失败，而仅学习“何时读取原经验”的门控也无法修复经验内容本身在某些子群中的错误归纳。
problem.en: The same experience can have opposite future effects across task subpopulations. Global keep/delete decisions fail, and merely learning when to retrieve the original memory cannot repair cases where the memory content itself induces the wrong abstraction for a subgroup.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设效应异质性只需要 applicability gating；改为假设一部分符号冲突来自经验内容中混合了可共享核心与子群特定错误归纳，因此需要学习会改变记忆内容的 descendant transformation。
changed_assumption.en: Effect heterogeneity is not assumed to require only applicability gating. Instead, some sign conflicts are assumed to arise because a memory mixes a reusable core with subgroup-specific misleading abstractions, requiring learned descendant transformations that modify memory content.

exact_mechanism.zh: 先对原始记忆 m 在随机化 replay 中估计条件处理效应 tau(x,m)，定位稳定的 effect-sign conflict 区域。仅当预注册异质性检验通过时启动分叉。一个共享 transformer 接收原记忆 m 与由任务可观察特征形成的 effect context c，输出受长度约束的 descendant delta Δm_c；后代记忆为 m_c=T(m,c)，而不是简单复制 m。训练目标要求：在该 context 下使用 m_c 比 withholding memory 提高成功率；在相反 context 下不继承原记忆的负效应；不同 descendants 通过共享-core regularizer 保留可验证共同事实，同时 contrastive effect loss 强迫它们产生不同决策。训练完成后冻结 transformer 与少量 prototype contexts。未来任务依据可观察特征生成或选择 descendant，不能访问 subgroup identity 标签。
exact_mechanism.en: First estimate the conditional treatment effect tau(x,m) of the original memory m from randomized replay and identify regions with stable effect-sign conflict. Bifurcation is activated only after a preregistered heterogeneity test passes. A shared transformer receives the original memory and an effect context c derived from observable task features, then outputs a length-constrained descendant delta Δm_c; the descendant is m_c=T(m,c), not a copy of m. Training requires m_c to outperform withholding the memory in its context, avoid inheriting the original memory's negative effect in opposing contexts, preserve verified shared facts through a shared-core regularizer, and induce distinct decisions across descendants through a contrastive effect loss. Freeze the transformer and a small set of prototype contexts. On future tasks, descendants are generated or selected from observable features without access to subgroup-identity labels.

children.update_surface: frozen context-conditioned descendant memory transformation operator with versioned lineage

learning_signal.zh: 随机化 replay 中原记忆、withhold、以及候选 descendant 三种条件下的任务结果差；子群效应符号；共享事实一致性；以及 descendants 是否真正改变下游动作分布。
learning_signal.en: Outcome differences among original-memory, withhold-memory, and candidate-descendant conditions in randomized replay; subgroup effect signs; shared-fact consistency; and whether descendants actually alter downstream action distributions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 隐藏评测按未见 subgroup identity 和未见领域切分，只暴露任务本身的可观察特征；最终效果由随机分配 descendant/original/withhold 三臂实验测量，而非由训练期 effect estimator 自己打分。
independent_ground_truth.en: Hidden evaluation is split by unseen subgroup identities and unseen domains, exposing only observable task features. Final effects are measured by randomized assignment among descendant, original-memory, and withhold-memory arms rather than scored by the training-time effect estimator.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 effect-conditioned contextual gate：从相同随机 replay 学习 tau(x,m)，始终保留同一份原始记忆，仅在预测效应为正时检索，否则 withholding；存储、推理调用、训练样本和 estimator 容量与 descendant 方法严格匹配。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched effect-conditioned contextual gate learned from the same randomized replay: retain a single unchanged memory and retrieve it only when predicted tau(x,m) is positive, otherwise withhold it, with storage, inference calls, training examples, and estimator capacity strictly matched to the descendant method.

decisive_pilot.zh: 设计一个可控低资源 memory benchmark，使一条经验包含“共享正确核心 + 在训练环境中成立但在另一机制子群中错误的策略归纳”。构造至少四个潜在 subgroup，并完整留出其中一个 subgroup identity 与一个领域；测试时只给可观察任务特征。比较 descendant transformer、effect gate、两份独立手工/聚类记忆和原始 keep/delete。严格匹配总 memory token、训练 replay 次数和推理调用。主要指标是在未见 subgroup/domain 上相对 withhold 的真实 randomized treatment effect、平均成功率以及原始记忆负迁移率。决定性结果要求 descendant 在 effect gate 已经选择“可用原记忆”的样本上仍显著更好，证明收益来自内容变换而不是更好的 retrieval gating。
decisive_pilot.en: Create a controllable low-resource memory benchmark where one experience contains a shared correct core plus a strategy abstraction valid in one training mechanism but wrong in another subgroup. Construct at least four latent subgroups and hold out one subgroup identity and one domain entirely; expose only observable task features at test time. Compare the descendant transformer with the effect gate, two independent hand-written or clustered memories, and global keep/delete. Match total memory tokens, training replays, and inference calls. Primary metrics are true randomized treatment effect relative to withholding, average success, and negative-transfer rate on unseen subgroup/domain splits. The decisive result must show that descendants outperform the effect gate even on examples where that gate already chooses to retrieve the original memory, demonstrating a content-transformation benefit rather than improved retrieval gating.

stop_condition.zh: 若在未见 subgroup identity 和领域上，effect-conditioned gate 在相同预算下达到等价效果，尤其是在 gate 判定应检索原记忆的样本中 descendant 不再有增益；或 descendants 与原记忆的行为差异可由 token 重写噪声解释，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the effect-conditioned gate matches performance under the same budget on unseen subgroup identities and domains, especially if descendants provide no gain on examples where the gate already retrieves the original memory, or if descendant behavioral differences are explainable by generic rewriting noise.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案通过随机化 replay 估计异质处理效应、检测 effect-sign conflict、维护版本化 descendant lineage 并冻结到未来任务的核心框架。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the parent's randomized-replay estimation of heterogeneous treatment effects, detection of effect-sign conflict, versioned descendant lineage, and freezing to future tasks.

material_change.zh: 后代不再只是带不同适用条件的原经验副本，而是由冻结 transformer 学到的子群条件内容变换；决定性实验专门在 applicability gate 已经做出正确读取决策的样本上检验后代是否仍产生额外收益。
material_change.en: Descendants are no longer copies of the original experience with different applicability conditions; they are subgroup-conditioned content transformations produced by a frozen transformer, and the decisive test isolates whether they add value even after the applicability gate has already made the correct retrieval decision.

problem.zh: 长期自进化会积累大量边际行为效应近似相同的记忆，但这些记忆在共同检索时可能产生不同的协同、抵消或冲突效应，因此按单条效应去重会误删不可替代经验。
problem.en: Long-running evolution accumulates memories with nearly identical marginal behavioral effects, yet those memories can exhibit different synergy, cancellation, or conflict under joint retrieval, making entry-wise effect deduplication unsafe.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设记忆的可替代性可由单条记忆的边际效应向量决定；目标改为学习集合级交互效应等价，使两个候选记忆只有在其与相关上下文记忆共同检索时仍保持行为效应时才可互换。
changed_assumption.en: Replace the assumption that substitutability is determined by marginal effect vectors with group-level interaction-effect equivalence: two memories are interchangeable only if their effects remain equivalent when jointly retrieved with relevant contextual memories.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对频繁共同检索的二元和三元记忆组执行受控加入、删除和替换干预，记录跨任务行为差分。由单项效应中扣除可加部分后估计 pair/triple interaction residual，并学习一个稀疏类型化超图：节点为记忆，超边存储条件交互签名与适用域。压缩时仅对在边际效应和所有已识别交互超边上均等价的节点构造 quotient class；类内可保留代表项，但任何具有不可忽略交互残差的成员保持独立。
exact_mechanism.en: Run controlled add, delete, and substitute interventions on frequently co-retrieved memory pairs and triples and record cross-task behavioral deltas. Subtract additive marginal effects to estimate pair/triple interaction residuals, then learn a sparse typed hypergraph whose hyperedges store conditional interaction signatures and applicability domains. Compression forms quotient classes only for memories equivalent both marginally and on all identified interaction hyperedges; members with significant residual interactions remain distinct.

learning_signal.zh: 监督信号是联合检索干预前后的独立任务结果差分，以及观测联合效应与各成员边际效应之和之间的 interaction residual；只有跨重复任务稳定出现的残差才写入超边。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes from independently measured task-outcome differences under joint-retrieval interventions and the interaction residual between observed joint effects and the sum of marginal effects; only residuals stable across repeated tasks are persisted as hyperedges.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由冻结环境或任务测试器直接判断成功率、约束满足、错误类型等结果，不使用压缩器自身的相似度或预测分数作为真值；最终等价性由压缩前后在未参与建图的任务上的行为保持程度验证。
independent_ground_truth.en: A frozen environment or task checker directly evaluates success, constraint satisfaction, and failure type; the compactor's own similarity or predicted scores are never ground truth. Final equivalence is validated by behavioral preservation on tasks excluded from hypergraph construction.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的单条跨任务效应签名与适用掩码，固定阈值聚类后每簇保留一个 medoid，并维护可逆 alias table；不给基线任何显式组级交互对象。
simplest_baseline.en: Using exactly the same marginal cross-task effect signatures and applicability masks, cluster under a fixed threshold, retain one medoid per cluster, and maintain a reversible alias table, with no explicit group-interaction object.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造或筛选至少 30 组三记忆集合，其中 A 与 B 的边际效应签名在阈值内不可区分，但在存在第三类记忆 C 时出现方向相反或幅度显著不同的联合效应。冻结两种压缩器，在未见任务和未见 memory identity 上比较联合检索后的行为保持率、错误合并率和压缩率。关键判据是：在压缩率匹配时，超图方法显著减少 medoid 基线对这些交互组的 false merge，同时在纯可加组上不牺牲压缩。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct or mine at least 30 three-memory sets where A and B have indistinguishable marginal signatures under the clustering threshold but exhibit opposite or substantially different joint effects in the presence of a third memory type C. Freeze both compactors and evaluate unseen tasks and unseen memory identities for joint-retrieval behavior preservation, false-merge rate, and compression. The decisive criterion is significantly fewer interaction-induced false merges than the medoid baseline at matched compression, without losing compression on additive groups.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量和压缩率匹配后，加入二元/三元交互对象不能在预注册的非加性交互集合上显著降低 false merge，或所有观测联合效应都可由边际效应加和解释，则停止该方向并收缩为基于干预效应的普通去重。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, at matched capacity and compression, pair/triple interaction objects do not significantly reduce false merges on the preregistered non-additive sets, or if observed joint effects are adequately explained by additive marginal effects; in that case reduce the contribution to intervention-effect-based deduplication.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的跨任务行为干预、适用边界、可逆来源追踪以及以实测效应而非文本相似度判断记忆冗余的核心原则。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits cross-task behavioral interventions, applicability boundaries, reversible provenance, and the principle of judging redundancy by measured effects rather than textual similarity.

material_change.zh: 学习对象从“单条效应向量的等价类”变为“带高阶交互残差的集合级等价关系”。因此代表项选择不再是核心贡献；真正不可约对象是能够阻止边际相似但联合行为不同的记忆被错误合并的持久交互超图。
material_change.en: The learned object changes from equivalence classes over individual effect vectors to a set-level equivalence relation containing higher-order interaction residuals. Representative selection is no longer the contribution; the irreducible object is the persistent interaction hypergraph that prevents merging memories with similar marginals but different joint behavior.

title.zh: 零锚点评价器状态外推器

problem.zh: Actor 与 evaluator 持续共同演化时，新 evaluator 版本可能产生此前未出现的版本配对偏差，而部署时通常无法立即获得该新版本的人工 anchor 标签。
problem.en: As actors and evaluators co-evolve, a new evaluator version can induce previously unseen version-pair biases, while human anchor labels for that new evaluator are often unavailable at deployment.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再依赖未来 evaluator 的少量真实标签进行校准，而是假设 evaluator 在无标签探针上的可观测行为指纹携带其潜在版本状态；该状态的时间动力学可从历史版本学习并外推到完全零 anchor 的未来版本。
changed_assumption.en: Remove reliance on a few ground-truth labels from the future evaluator. Instead assume that observable responses to unlabeled diagnostic probes encode a latent evaluator-version state whose temporal dynamics can be learned from historical versions and extrapolated to a truly zero-anchor future version.

exact_mechanism.zh: 为每个历史 evaluator 在固定无标签 probe bank 上采集 logits、置信度、长度偏好、位置翻转敏感性和自一致性等 fingerprint。编码器将 fingerprint 映射到低维状态 z_t，并用按时间顺序训练的状态转移模型预测 z_{t+1}。历史 actor×evaluator 交叉评分仅用于学习从 actor 描述与 z_t 到偏差残差的条件修正头。测试时新 evaluator 只能运行无标签 probe；禁止读取该版本的任何人工或任务真值标签，生成 z_new 后直接修正其评分。
exact_mechanism.en: For each historical evaluator, collect a fingerprint on a fixed unlabeled probe bank, including logits, confidence, length preference, position-flip sensitivity, and self-consistency. An encoder maps the fingerprint to a low-dimensional state z_t, and a chronologically trained transition model predicts the next-state manifold. Historical actor-by-evaluator crossed scores train a conditional correction head from actor descriptors and z_t to score bias. At test time the new evaluator may only answer unlabeled probes; no human or task labels from that version are allowed, and its inferred z_new directly conditions score correction.

children.update_surface: persistent latent evaluator-version state transition model and frozen bias-correction head

learning_signal.zh: 状态表示由历史无标签 fingerprint 的时间预测和重构损失学习；偏差头使用仅来自历史版本的独立人工/任务真值与 evaluator 分数残差训练。未来版本标签严格不进入任何更新。
learning_signal.en: The state representation is learned from temporal prediction and reconstruction of historical unlabeled fingerprints; the bias head is trained on evaluator residuals against independent human/task ground truth from historical versions only. Labels from the future version are strictly excluded from all updates.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 评价真值由在模型训练完成后才揭示的人工偏好、多评审共识或可程序验证任务结果给出；这些标签仅用于最终评估 held-out evaluator version，而不参与其状态估计。
independent_ground_truth.en: Ground truth consists of human preferences, multi-rater consensus, or programmatically verified task outcomes revealed only after model training; these labels are used solely to evaluate the held-out evaluator version and never to infer its state.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的静态 pooled calibration head，输入完全相同的 actor descriptor、新 evaluator 无标签 fingerprint、版本元数据和 recency，但把这些量当作普通协变量，不学习显式时间状态转移或跨版本外推算子。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched pooled static calibration head receiving exactly the same actor descriptors, new-evaluator unlabeled fingerprint, version metadata, and recency as ordinary covariates, but with no explicit temporal latent-state transition or cross-version extrapolation operator.

decisive_pilot.zh: 按发布时间排序至少 5 个 evaluator checkpoint，以最后一个版本做完全 zero-anchor 测试。训练阶段仅允许前序版本真值；测试阶段两方法都可访问最后版本同一套无标签 probes。比较其对最后版本 actor×evaluator 配对偏差的 MAE、排序反转率和人类一致性恢复。再逐步删除时间转移，仅保留同维 fingerprint encoder，验证收益来自历史动力学而非更多参数。
decisive_pilot.en: Chronologically order at least five evaluator checkpoints and hold out the final version under a strict zero-anchor protocol. Training may use ground truth only from earlier versions; at test time both methods access the identical unlabeled probe set from the final evaluator. Compare MAE of actor-evaluator pair bias, ranking-flip rate, and recovery of agreement with humans. Ablate the temporal transition while retaining an equal-dimensional fingerprint encoder to test whether gains arise from longitudinal dynamics rather than parameter count.

stop_condition.zh: 若在两个以上 held-out chronological splits 上，显式状态转移模型不能持续优于使用完全相同无标签 fingerprint 的静态校准器，或其优势在去掉版本时间顺序后仍保持，则停止“纵向外推”主张并退化为 fingerprint-based calibration。
stop_condition.en: Stop the longitudinal-extrapolation claim if the explicit state-transition model fails to consistently outperform the static calibrator with identical unlabeled fingerprints on at least two chronological held-out splits, or if its advantage persists after destroying version chronology; then reduce the method to fingerprint-based calibration.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案的 actor-version × evaluator-version 交叉视角、独立真值锚定和对版本配对特异偏差进行修正的目标。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the crossed actor-version by evaluator-version perspective, independent ground-truth anchoring, and the goal of correcting version-pair-specific bias.

material_change.zh: 父方案依赖 anchor 后拟合交互残差；子方案把不可约对象改为可在未来标签出现前估计的 evaluator 潜在版本状态及其时间转移，并用严格 zero-anchor chronological extrapolation 检验其是否提供静态校准无法获得的信息。
material_change.en: The parent fit interaction residuals around anchors; the child makes the irreducible object an evaluator latent version state and temporal transition estimable before any future labels exist, tested by strict zero-anchor chronological extrapolation against a static calibrator with identical observables.

title.zh: 高阶类型化记忆顺序逻辑

problem.zh: 多条记忆单独均有帮助，但某些顺序约束只在特定第三类记忆或组合上下文存在时成立，因此固定标量排序或成对优先分数无法避免组合性覆盖和冲突。
problem.en: Multiple memories may each be useful, yet some ordering constraints hold only in the presence of a third memory type or a particular composition, so scalar ranking and pairwise precedence scores cannot prevent compositional override and conflict.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把正确检索顺序视为每条记忆的标量优先级或固定 pairwise preference，而将其定义为基于预先独立类型的条件高阶关系，包括 context-dependent precedence、commutativity 和三元约束。
changed_assumption.en: Replace the assumption that correct retrieval order is a scalar priority or fixed pairwise preference with conditional higher-order relations over independently defined memory types, including context-dependent precedence, commutativity, and ternary constraints.

exact_mechanism.zh: memory type 在任何顺序实验之前由来源和功能契约确定，例如 observation、policy、exception、tool-schema、safety-constraint，而不是由最终排序标签聚类得到。训练时对共同检索集合做随机排列干预，收集任务结果，并诱导最小化的类型化 Horn-style clauses，例如 C_present => A≺B、D_present => B≺A、commute(A,B)|¬C，以及 forbid(A between B,C)。推理时冻结 clause registry，把当前 memory identities 映射到既定类型，并用约束求解得到满足高阶子句的顺序。
exact_mechanism.en: Memory types are defined before any ordering experiment from provenance and functional contracts, such as observation, policy, exception, tool-schema, or safety-constraint, rather than being clustered from ordering labels. Random permutation interventions over co-retrieved sets yield task outcomes from which a minimal typed Horn-style clause set is induced, such as C_present => A≺B, D_present => B≺A, commute(A,B)|¬C, and forbid(A between B,C). At inference the frozen clause registry maps unseen memory identities to predefined types and a constraint solver produces an order satisfying the higher-order clauses.

children.update_surface: persistent higher-order typed memory-order clause registry

learning_signal.zh: 同一共同检索集合不同排列导致的独立任务成败、约束违反和输出差异形成监督；只保留在多个 memory identity 上重复成立且能减少验证错误的最小高阶子句。
learning_signal.en: Independent task success, constraint violations, and output differences across permutations of the same co-retrieved set provide supervision; only minimal higher-order clauses that recur across multiple memory identities and reduce validation error are persisted.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 正确性由外部环境奖励、单元测试、任务规则或人工冻结 rubric 判定；memory type 标签来自事先定义的来源/接口元数据，不能依据排列结果事后重标。
independent_ground_truth.en: Correctness is determined by external environment rewards, unit tests, task rules, or a frozen human rubric. Memory-type labels come from predefined provenance/interface metadata and cannot be relabeled after observing permutation outcomes.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的排列数据、类型输入和参数预算训练容量匹配的 pairwise order-effect scorer，为任意两类记忆输出固定方向/分数，再通过 tournament 或 topological sorting 生成顺序，不允许三元条件或组合依赖关系。
simplest_baseline.en: Train a capacity-matched pairwise order-effect scorer on the identical permutation data, type inputs, and parameter budget. It assigns a fixed direction or score to each pair and uses tournament or topological sorting, with no ternary conditions or composition-dependent relations.

decisive_pilot.zh: 建立一个预注册集合，其中至少包含三类不可被固定 pairwise relation 表达的结构：存在 C 时 A≺B、无 C 时 A 与 B 可交换；存在 D 时关系反转；以及只有三元连续布局才能成功的约束。训练身份集合与测试身份完全 disjoint，并留出至少一种 type composition。比较 clause registry 与 pairwise scorer 在未见 identity、未见 composition 上的顺序成功率；随后把同一 registry 冻结迁移到第二个基础模型。
decisive_pilot.en: Create a preregistered suite with at least three structures impossible for fixed pairwise relations: A≺B only when C is present while A and B commute otherwise; a relation reversal in the presence of D; and a success condition requiring a ternary adjacency pattern. Use disjoint train/test memory identities and hold out at least one type composition. Compare ordering success of the clause registry and pairwise scorer on unseen identities and unseen compositions, then freeze the same registry and transfer it to a second base model.

stop_condition.zh: 若容量匹配的 pairwise scorer 在预注册高阶测试上达到与 clause registry 等价的成功率，或类型规则不能迁移到未见 identity/type composition，则停止高阶逻辑主张并将方案收缩为学习式检索排序。
stop_condition.en: Stop the higher-order logic claim if the capacity-matched pairwise scorer matches the clause registry on the preregistered higher-order tests, or if typed rules fail to transfer to unseen identities/type compositions; then reduce the method to learned retrieval ordering.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案对共同检索集合做随机排列干预、从真实任务结果学习持久顺序约束以及在推理前修改未来检索顺序的基本框架。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits randomized permutation interventions over co-retrieved memories, persistent constraint learning from real task outcomes, and modification of future retrieval order before inference.

material_change.zh: 学习对象从可能被 pairwise scorer 吸收的 precedence 标签改成严格需要组合上下文的类型化高阶逻辑；独立定义类型并加入关系反转、条件可交换和三元约束，使简化基线在表示层面存在可检验的缺口。
material_change.en: The target changes from precedence labels potentially absorbable by a pairwise scorer to typed higher-order logic that strictly depends on composition. Independently defined types plus reversals, conditional commutativity, and ternary constraints create a testable representational gap from the simpler baseline.

problem.zh: 通用子 Agent 在重复任务 motif 上不仅浪费角色描述上下文，还会因工具调用顺序、状态交接和退出条件缺乏持久结构而反复产生相同的协调错误。
problem.en: General subagents handling recurring task motifs waste role-description context and repeatedly incur the same coordination errors because tool sequencing, state handoff, and termination semantics lack persistent structure.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把“角色专化”视为更好的角色 Prompt，而把可迁移知识定义为可执行的有限状态契约：它必须改变哪些动作可调用、何时可调用、必须产生哪些交接状态以及何时强制退出。
changed_assumption.en: Role specialization is no longer treated as a better role prompt. The transferable object is an executable finite-state contract that changes which actions may be called, when they may be called, what handoff state must be produced, and when execution must terminate.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从成功和失败轨迹中先按任务 motif 学习路由，但编译阶段只提取跨多个任务重复出现的状态-动作约束，形成 versioned role contract：输入 schema、允许工具集合、参数 schema、前置条件、有限状态转移、输出/交接 schema、最大调用预算和强制 termination predicate。运行时由外部 contract executor 拦截非法工具调用、阻止未满足前置条件的转移，并在 termination predicate 满足时终止角色，而不是仅把这些规则写入 Prompt。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn motif routing from successful and failed traces, but compile only state-action constraints recurring across multiple tasks into a versioned role contract: input schema, allowed tool set, parameter schemas, preconditions, finite-state transitions, output/handoff schema, maximum call budget, and mandatory termination predicates. At runtime an external contract executor blocks illegal tool calls and unsatisfied transitions and terminates the role when its predicate fires, rather than merely describing these rules in a prompt.

children.update_surface: versioned frozen library of executable role finite-state contracts and router

learning_signal.zh: 利用轨迹中经独立任务判定的成功、工具错误、无效循环、错误交接和提前/延迟终止事件，选择能跨任务降低这些失败且不损害成功路径的最小状态-动作约束。
learning_signal.en: Independently judged trajectory outcomes—task success, tool errors, invalid loops, bad handoffs, and premature or delayed termination—supervise selection of the minimal state-action constraints that reduce failures across tasks without blocking successful paths.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 任务结果由环境测试、程序检查器或冻结 evaluator 判定；契约执行器仅负责许可和状态转换，不能决定自身是否成功。held-out 评估在契约库冻结后进行。
independent_ground_truth.en: Task outcomes are determined by environment tests, programmatic checkers, or a frozen evaluator; the contract executor only enforces permissions and transitions and cannot judge its own success. Held-out evaluation occurs after the contract library is frozen.

simplest_baseline.zh: 容量匹配的 motif retrieval + dynamic-role baseline：使用完全相同的 motif 聚类、学习路由器、工具权限集合、exit guards、训练样本、推理调用次数和 token 预算，但每次根据检索 motif 动态生成普通角色 Prompt，不复用冻结的有限状态转移、schema 交接或可执行前置条件。
simplest_baseline.en: A capacity-matched motif-retrieval plus dynamic-role baseline using the identical motif clustering, learned router, tool permission sets, exit guards, training examples, inference calls, and token budget, but dynamically generating an ordinary role prompt for each retrieved motif without reusing frozen finite-state transitions, handoff schemas, or executable preconditions.

decisive_pilot.zh: 选择 3 至 5 个重复 motif、至少两个训练任务族和一个完全 held-out 任务族。学习后冻结 router 和 contract library。对 held-out family 比较完整 executable contract、dynamic-role baseline，以及“同一 router+permissions+exit guards 但移除状态机编译”的直接消融。主要指标为任务成功率、非法动作率、循环调用率、平均 token/tool calls；若资源允许，再把完全冻结的契约库迁移到第二个 base model，仅重新映射工具 API 名称。
decisive_pilot.en: Use 3–5 recurring motifs, at least two training task families, and one fully held-out family. Freeze the router and contract library after learning. On the held-out family compare the full executable contracts, the dynamic-role baseline, and a direct ablation retaining the same router, permissions, and exit guards while removing compiled state-machine semantics. Primary metrics are task success, illegal-action rate, looping rate, and average tokens/tool calls. If resources permit, transfer the fully frozen library to a second base model while only remapping tool API names.

stop_condition.zh: 若在相同 router、权限和退出规则下，移除有限状态转移和可执行前置/交接约束后性能不下降，或 dynamic-role baseline 在 held-out family 上等价，则停止“编译”贡献并将结果收缩为 motif retrieval/routing。
stop_condition.en: Stop the compilation claim if removing finite-state transitions and executable precondition/handoff constraints causes no degradation with the same router, permissions, and exit rules, or if the dynamic-role baseline is equivalent on held-out families; then reduce the contribution to motif retrieval/routing.

what_is_inherited.zh: 保留父方案的跨任务 motif 发现、角色库版本化、学习式路由以及从重复成功/失败轨迹中提炼稳定职责的思路。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits cross-task motif discovery, versioned role storage, learned routing, and extraction of stable responsibilities from recurring successful and failed trajectories.

material_change.zh: 父方案中的“契约”可能只是文本角色描述；子方案将持久对象变为外部执行的状态机和接口契约，即使基础模型生成相同文本，也会因允许动作、状态转换和强制终止不同而产生不同未来行为。
material_change.en: The parent's contracts could collapse to textual role descriptions. The child turns the persistent object into externally executed state machines and interface contracts, so even identical model text can yield different future behavior through action gating, state transitions, and mandatory termination.

title.zh: 交互条件非线性更新逆算子

problem.zh: 多个单独有益的更新在组合后可能产生新的非加性回归，而撤销任意已有更新原子的子集都无法恢复目标行为，因此传统 subset rollback 会在修复失败与丢失收益之间二选一。
problem.en: Individually beneficial updates can create a new non-additive regression when combined, while reverting any subset of the stored update atoms cannot restore the desired behavior, forcing conventional subset rollback to choose between failed repair and lost benefits.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设有害效应位于已有 update-delta 原子的线性张成空间内。逆操作必须依据组合后的交互证据合成一个新的 residual repair direction，并以当前更新组合和失败上下文为条件。
changed_assumption.en: Remove the assumption that harmful effects lie in the linear span of stored update-delta atoms. The inverse must synthesize a new residual repair direction from interaction evidence, conditioned on the current update composition and failure context.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对历史更新组合执行单原子、成对和完整组合的部分回滚干预，计算组合效果相对于各原子效果之和的 interaction residual。训练一个小型条件 patch generator，以更新原子摘要、交互 residual、失败探针表示和保留行为约束为输入，输出固定低秩 repair adapter 的系数与新方向。训练时显式投影掉可由已存原子 delta 线性组合解释的分量，使生成器只学习 span 外 residual；生成的 patch 经安全门控后写入持久 inverse library，供同类未见更新组合直接调用。
exact_mechanism.en: Perform single-atom, pairwise, and full-composition partial rollback interventions on historical update combinations and compute interaction residuals relative to the sum of atomic effects. Train a small conditional patch generator taking update-atom summaries, interaction residuals, failure-probe representations, and preservation constraints to output coefficients and new directions for a fixed low-rank repair adapter. During training, explicitly project away components explainable by linear combinations of stored atom deltas so the generator learns only out-of-span residuals; validated patches are persisted in an inverse library for future unseen update combinations.

children.update_surface: persistent interaction-conditioned nonlinear inverse-patch generator and inverse library

learning_signal.zh: 信号来自部分回滚干预后的独立回归测试：最小化组合更新引入的失败，同时约束每个原更新带来的保留收益；额外监督是完整组合效应减去原子/线性组合预测后的非加性交互 residual。
learning_signal.en: Supervision comes from independent regression tests after partial rollback interventions: eliminate failures introduced by the composed update while preserving benefits of each original update. An additional target is the non-additive interaction residual after subtracting atomic or linear-combination predictions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 使用冻结的任务测试集、程序验证器或与更新训练过程独立的人工 rubric 衡量回归和保留收益；逆生成器自身的 residual prediction 不作为修复成功真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Regression and benefit preservation are measured by frozen task suites, programmatic verifiers, or human rubrics independent of update training; the inverter's own residual prediction is never treated as repair ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: oracle subset/linear rollback：给予基线完全相同的 update atoms 和部分干预数据，并允许其知道哪些原子与失败相关；在所有已存原子 delta 的任意子集及任意线性组合中搜索最优回滚，再给予与子方案相同参数量的非条件固定 residual adapter，但该 adapter 不接收交互状态或更新组合。
simplest_baseline.en: An oracle subset/linear rollback baseline receives the identical update atoms and partial-intervention data and may know which atoms are associated with the failure. It searches over any subset and any linear combination of stored atom deltas, then receives an equal-parameter unconditional residual adapter that is not conditioned on interaction state or update composition.

decisive_pilot.zh: 用公开小模型和 LoRA/adapter 更新构造至少 20 个耦合组合：每个单独更新改善自己的目标任务，但联合应用后在独立 regression set 上失败；通过离线搜索确认不存在任何 stored atom delta 子集或线性组合能够同时恢复回归并保留预注册比例的单项收益。随后在未见组合上比较 oracle linear rollback 与冻结 conditional inverter 的恢复率、保留收益和 patch norm。决定性结果是逆算子成功修复一类已被验证位于 stored-delta span 外的交互回归。
decisive_pilot.en: Using a public small model and LoRA/adapter updates, construct at least 20 coupled compositions where every individual update improves its own target task but their joint application fails an independent regression suite. Offline search must verify that no subset or linear combination of stored atom deltas can both fix the regression and preserve a preregistered fraction of individual gains. On unseen compositions compare oracle linear rollback with the frozen conditional inverter for repair rate, benefit preservation, and patch norm. The decisive result is successful repair of regressions verified to lie outside the stored-delta span.

stop_condition.zh: 若所有可复现回归都能被 oracle subset/linear rollback 修复，或 conditional inverter 在真正 span 外案例上不能比容量匹配 residual baseline 提高修复率，则停止该方向；这说明没有证据支持学习非线性逆算子的必要性。
stop_condition.en: Stop if all reproducible regressions can be repaired by oracle subset/linear rollback, or if the conditional inverter fails to outperform the capacity-matched residual baseline on verified out-of-span cases; then there is no evidence that a learned nonlinear inverse is necessary.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案的部分回滚干预、只抵消有害更新效应而保留有益部分的目标，以及把逆操作作为可复用持久对象的思路。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits partial rollback interventions, the objective of canceling harmful update effects while preserving beneficial ones, and the idea of storing reusable inverse behavior as a persistent object.

material_change.zh: 父方案可被“识别有害原子并取负”完全替代；子方案把实验域限制到已有原子任意选择和线性组合都已证明不足的耦合更新，并要求学习一个依赖交互状态、能生成 span 外新修复方向的条件逆算子。
material_change.en: The parent could collapse to identifying harmful atoms and negating them. The child restricts the target regime to coupled updates where every subset and linear combination of stored atoms is demonstrably insufficient and requires an interaction-conditioned inverse that generates a new out-of-span repair direction.

title.zh: 冻结式更新差分到失败族策略

problem.zh: 固定回归集和每次从完整当前状态重新生成测试都缺乏跨更新历史的经验：某些结构化更新 diff 会反复诱发特定失败族，但这些先验不会被持久学习并迁移到新的更新类型。
problem.en: Fixed regression suites and regenerating tests from the full current state each time fail to accumulate cross-update experience: particular structural update diffs repeatedly induce specific failure families, yet these priors are not persistently learned and transferred to new update types.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把 update diff 仅作为一次性 Prompt 条件，而把核心学习对象定义为跨更新训练的参数化策略 π(failure-family | structural-diff)，其参数只由独立验证的历史失败更新，并在测试新更新前完全冻结。
changed_assumption.en: The update diff is no longer merely a one-shot prompting condition. The core learned object is a cross-update parameterized policy π(failure-family | structural-diff), updated only from independently verified historical failures and fully frozen before testing new updates.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把 prompt、memory、tool schema 或 skill 更新规范化为结构 diff 图，节点表示新增、删除、重写的规则/权限/检索项，边表示作用域、依赖和冲突关系。轻量 policy encoder 将 diff 图映射到固定 failure-family vocabulary 上的分布，例如 over-generalization、scope leak、priority inversion、tool misuse、stale retrieval、termination regression。生成预算首先按该分布分配给相应挑战模板，再由同一个通用生成器实例化具体任务。只有经独立 verifier 确认的真实回归才用于对 policy 做 bandit/contrastive 更新；训练结束后冻结 policy，在 held-out update type 上直接预测测试族。
exact_mechanism.en: Normalize prompt, memory, tool-schema, or skill changes into structural diff graphs whose nodes encode added, deleted, or rewritten rules/permissions/retrieval items and whose edges encode scope, dependency, and conflict. A lightweight policy encoder maps the diff graph to a distribution over a fixed failure-family vocabulary such as over-generalization, scope leak, priority inversion, tool misuse, stale retrieval, and termination regression. Generation budget is allocated according to this distribution and the same generic generator instantiates concrete tests. Only regressions confirmed by an independent verifier update the policy through bandit/contrastive learning. After training, the policy is frozen and predicts test families for held-out update types.

learning_signal.zh: 每个生成挑战由独立 verifier 标记为 true regression、旧失败、无效挑战或通过；策略奖励仅来自相对于 pre-update 行为新增且可复现的 true regression，并可按覆盖的新失败族和后续修复收益加权。
learning_signal.en: Each generated challenge is labeled by an independent verifier as a true regression, pre-existing failure, invalid challenge, or pass. Policy reward comes only from reproducible regressions newly introduced relative to the pre-update state, optionally weighted by novel failure-family coverage and downstream repair gain.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 同一挑战必须在 pre-update 与 post-update agent 上成对执行；只有 pre-update 通过、post-update 失败且被程序测试器、环境反馈或冻结外部 judge 确认时才算更新诱发回归。challenge policy 与生成器自身不能给自己打真值标签。
independent_ground_truth.en: Every challenge is executed on paired pre-update and post-update agents. It counts as an update-induced regression only when the pre-update agent passes, the post-update agent fails, and a programmatic checker, environment signal, or frozen external judge confirms the difference. Neither the challenge policy nor generator may label its own outputs as ground truth.

simplest_baseline.zh: 忽略 diff 的 strongest full-state baseline：读取完全相同的 post-update 当前状态，进行 specification extraction，再用同一个通用对抗生成器产生测试，并把独立验证的 hard examples 存入 replay buffer；与子方案严格匹配生成调用数、verifier 调用数、repair 算法、总 token、replay 容量和可访问的历史更新数量。
simplest_baseline.en: The strongest full-state baseline ignores the diff, reads the identical complete post-update state, extracts specifications, uses the same generic adversarial generator to create tests, and stores independently verified hard examples in a replay buffer. Generation calls, verifier calls, repair algorithm, total tokens, replay capacity, and accessible update history are exactly matched.

decisive_pilot.zh: 收集或程序化产生多类 prompt/memory/tool updates，按结构更新类型划分 train/held-out，而不是随机划分具体样本。历史更新训练 policy 后冻结。在每个 held-out update 上给两方法完全相同的挑战数和 verifier/token 预算，比较单位预算发现的独立 true regressions、failure-family recall 和将这些回归交给同一 repair algorithm 后的 held-out regression reduction。关键对照再给 full-state baseline 历史 hard-example replay，检验收益是否仍来自 diff→failure-family 的跨更新映射，而不是积累更多失败样本。
decisive_pilot.en: Collect or programmatically generate multiple classes of prompt, memory, and tool updates and split by structural update type rather than randomly by example. Train the policy on historical updates and freeze it. For every held-out update, give both methods identical challenge counts and verifier/token budgets and compare independently verified true regressions per budget, failure-family recall, and held-out regression reduction after feeding discoveries to the same repair algorithm. The key control also gives the full-state baseline historical hard-example replay, testing whether gains still arise from the learned diff-to-failure-family mapping rather than simply accumulating more failures.

stop_condition.zh: 若在至少两个 held-out update-type splits 上，冻结 diff policy 不能在等预算下发现比 full-state specification + generic adversarial generation + hard-example replay 更多的独立新回归，或发现量增加但不能带来同一修复算法的额外 held-out 改善，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if, on at least two held-out update-type splits, the frozen diff policy fails to discover more independently verified new regressions under matched budget than full-state specification extraction plus generic adversarial generation and hard-example replay, or if extra discoveries do not yield additional held-out improvement under the same repair algorithm.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承父方案对更新诱发脆弱性的关注、pre/post update 差异、挑战生成和经独立验证失败回流修复的闭环。
what_is_inherited.en: Inherits the focus on update-induced vulnerabilities, pre/post-update comparison, challenge generation, and the closed loop in which independently verified failures feed downstream repair.

material_change.zh: 父方案的持久 curriculum 可能只是失败样本列表，且 diff conditioning 可以被读取完整状态的一次性生成器替代；子方案显式训练并冻结一个参数化跨更新先验，唯一需要存活的科学对象是 structural diff 到 failure-family 分布的可迁移映射，并通过 held-out update-type transfer 与强 full-state baseline 正面对比。
material_change.en: The parent's persistent curriculum could collapse to a list of hard examples, while diff conditioning could be replaced by one-shot generation from the full state. The child explicitly trains and freezes a parameterized cross-update prior whose irreducible scientific object is a transferable mapping from structural diffs to failure-family distributions, directly tested on held-out update types against the strongest full-state baseline.

title.zh: 限探针 API 转移算子

problem.zh: 跨 API 迁移时，名称和 schema 相似的调用仍可能具有不同的前置条件、状态效果与错误恢复语义，导致工作流主路径可运行但恢复分支失效。
problem.en: Across API migrations, calls with similar names and schemas can still differ in preconditions, state effects, and error-recovery semantics, so the main workflow may execute while recovery branches silently break.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设可通过开放式试错逐步理解目标 API；目标侧信息被严格限制为文档、schema 和恰好 N 次执行 probe，因此迁移必须依赖可冻结复用的显式语义转移对象。
changed_assumption.en: The repair no longer assumes open-ended target-side trial and error. Target observability is restricted to documentation, schema, and exactly N execution probes, forcing migration to rely on an explicit reusable semantic transition object.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把每个 API 操作表示为类型化转移算子 T=(P,E,X)：P 是调用前可判定的状态谓词，E 是成功调用后的状态差分，X 是错误类型到可恢复状态及允许恢复动作的转移。训练阶段在多个源 API family 上，对语义对应操作执行受控状态对和故障注入，学习共享的 P/E/X 参数化算子。迁移到新 API 时，只允许读取文档/schema 并执行固定 N 个主动选择的 probe 来实例化目标操作的算子参数；随后先把源工作流编译为算子图，再从算子图生成目标调用与恢复边。完成 N 个 probe 后冻结算子和编译结果，之后不再允许执行反馈修补。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent every API operation as a typed transition operator T=(P,E,X): P is a decidable pre-call state predicate, E is the post-success state delta, and X maps error classes to recoverable states and admissible recovery actions. During training, controlled state pairs and fault injections across multiple source API families supervise a shared parameterization of P/E/X. For a new API, the method may read only documentation/schema and issue a fixed N actively selected probes to instantiate target operator parameters. The source workflow is then compiled into an operator graph and emitted as target calls plus recovery edges. After the N probes, both operator and compiled workflow are frozen with no execution-repair loop.

learning_signal.zh: 训练信号来自执行前后状态差分、故障注入得到的错误类别、恢复动作后的状态，以及跨 API 语义对应操作之间的转移一致性损失；目标 API 上仅使用预先固定的 N 个 probe 产生这些观测。
learning_signal.en: Learning uses pre/post execution state differences, injected-error classes, post-recovery states, and transition-consistency losses across semantically corresponding operations. On the target API, these observations may come only from the predetermined N probes.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由不参与训练或 probe 选择的测试 harness 为每个目标 API 构造隐藏状态前置条件、预期效果和故障恢复 oracle，并在未暴露给方法的恢复分支上判定语义是否保持。
independent_ground_truth.en: An independent test harness, excluded from training and probe selection, specifies hidden preconditions, expected effects, and fault-recovery oracles for each target API and evaluates semantic preservation on unrevealed recovery branches.

simplest_baseline.zh: 使用完全相同的源/目标文档、schema、N 次目标 probe、token 和调用预算，让 LLM 直接重写工作流，并在相同预算内执行修复；同时加入固定手工通用 IR 的编译版本。
simplest_baseline.en: Direct LLM workflow rewriting using exactly the same source/target documentation, schemas, N target probes, tokens, and calls, followed by the same bounded execution-repair budget; also include compilation through a fixed hand-designed general IR.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在至少两个训练未见 API family 上迁移包含正常路径和多种恢复分支的小型工作流。所有方法获得相同 N 次目标调用。N 次调用后冻结并在隐藏故障注入集上执行。关键指标是恢复分支语义保持率和端到端任务成功率。只有当学习的 T 算子在相同预算下显著提高隐藏恢复分支保持率，并且该优势在第二个 API family 上复现，才支持机制。
decisive_pilot.en: Migrate small workflows containing normal and multiple recovery branches to at least two unseen API families. Every method receives exactly N target calls, after which it is frozen and evaluated under hidden fault injections. The decisive endpoints are recovery-branch semantic preservation and end-to-end success. The mechanism survives only if the learned T operator improves hidden recovery preservation under the identical budget and the gain replicates on a second API family.

stop_condition.zh: 如果在相同 N-probe、调用和修复预算下，冻结转移算子不能优于直接重写加执行修复，或其优势只存在于训练中出现过的 API family，则停止该方向。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the frozen transition operator does not beat direct rewriting plus execution repair under identical N-probe, call, and repair budgets, or if its advantage disappears on unseen API families.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承跨 API 前置条件、效果和错误恢复语义才是迁移核心，以及必须保持恢复分支的原始问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the premise that migration depends on cross-API precondition, effect, and error semantics and that recovery branches, not only nominal execution, must be preserved.

material_change.zh: 父方案的宽泛“语义 IR”被替换为可直接检验的 P/E/X 转移算子，并取消开放式目标侧修复：目标观测被硬限制为 N 个 probe，随后完全冻结，从而使跨 API 语义学习与直接重写的差异可识别。
material_change.en: The parent's broad semantic IR is replaced by a directly testable P/E/X transition operator, while open-ended target repair is removed. Target observation is hard-capped at N probes followed by freezing, making the learned semantic mechanism identifiable against direct rewriting.

title.zh: 随机微分配下一单位收益控制器

problem.zh: 多轮模型演化后，近期学习进展可能把因模型版本变化产生的新训练收益与任务本身的自然波动混为一谈，使课程持续投入已经饱和的任务或错过新失败边界。
problem.en: Across repeated model-evolution rounds, recent learning progress can confound version-induced changes in training return with ordinary task noise, causing curricula to keep funding saturated tasks or miss newly valuable failure boundaries.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再把观察到的 loss、成功率斜率或失败率变化当作某任务下一单位训练预算的收益；核心对象改为通过随机预算干预识别的、版本条件化的因果边际收益。
changed_assumption.en: Observed loss, success-rate slopes, or failure-rate changes are no longer treated as the return of the next unit of training. The learned object becomes version-conditioned causal marginal gain identified through randomized allocation interventions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 每轮训练预算中预留固定比例 epsilon 作为随机微分配：对候选任务族按已记录的非零探索概率随机增加一个微型训练块，其余预算由当前控制器分配。对每次微分配记录模型版本表示 v、任务族 k、分配概率 p、训练前后独立验证集指标差和回归指标。使用 inverse-propensity 或 doubly-robust 估计器学习 g(v,k)，即在版本 v 下把下一单位训练给任务 k 的因果效用及置信区间。下一轮只依据 g 的保守下界分配主要预算，同时保留固定回归锚点。训练完成后冻结 g，并将其直接用于另一条未参与拟合的模型版本序列。
exact_mechanism.en: Reserve a fixed epsilon fraction of every training round for randomized micro-allocations: candidate task families receive an extra micro-training block according to logged nonzero exploration probabilities, while the remaining budget follows the current controller. Each intervention logs model-version representation v, task family k, allocation propensity p, independent pre/post validation change, and regression metrics. An inverse-propensity or doubly robust estimator learns g(v,k), the causal utility and uncertainty of assigning the next training unit to task k at version v. The main budget is allocated using a conservative lower bound on g while fixed regression anchors are retained. After training, g is frozen and applied to a separate model-version stream.

learning_signal.zh: 具有已知随机分配概率的任务微训练干预，以及干预前后独立 held-out 能力指标和回归指标的差值。
learning_signal.en: Randomized task micro-training interventions with known assignment propensities and the resulting changes in independent held-out capability and regression metrics.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 对评测版本额外执行不提供给控制器的均匀随机微分配实验，用真实的下一训练块后 held-out 指标变化作为任务族因果收益排序真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: For evaluation versions, run additional uniformly randomized micro-allocations hidden from the controller and use the realized held-out change after the next training block as ground truth for causal task-return ranking.

simplest_baseline.zh: TSCL 风格控制器：在完全相同总训练预算和回归下限下，仅依据近期 held-out 学习进展斜率分配任务，不学习版本漂移或因果收益模型。
simplest_baseline.en: A TSCL-style controller using the identical total training budget and regression floor, reallocating tasks solely from recent held-out learning-progress slopes without a learned drift or causal-gain model.

decisive_pilot.zh: 使用一个可公开复现的小模型和 6 至 10 个任务族构造两条独立版本流，每个新版本通过固定的小规模 continued-training 或 adapter update 产生。第一条版本流学习 g，第二条完全冻结迁移。每轮都用相同训练 token。首先比较各方法预测“下一微训练块最值得给哪个任务”的 top-1/regret，再比较固定总预算后的宏平均能力与回归。决定性结果必须是在第二条版本流上，g 对随机干预真值的 next-unit regret 低于 TSCL、失败率和遗忘启发式，并转化为更高最终效用。
decisive_pilot.en: Use a publicly reproducible small model with 6-10 task families and construct two independent version streams via fixed small continued-training or adapter updates. Learn g only on the first stream and transfer it frozen to the second, with identical training tokens per round. First compare methods on regret for predicting which task should receive the next micro-block using randomized-intervention ground truth, then compare final macro capability and regression under the same total budget. The decisive result is lower next-unit regret than TSCL, failure-rate, and forgetting heuristics on the second stream, coupled with higher final utility.

stop_condition.zh: 如果因果收益估计在独立版本流上的下一单位收益预测不优于简单学习进展，或更准确的收益预测不能改善固定预算下的最终训练结果，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if causal-gain estimates do not outperform simple learning progress in next-unit return prediction on the independent version stream, or if improved prediction fails to improve final training outcomes under a fixed budget.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承多轮模型更新会使课程变陈旧、需要重新分配训练预算并保留回归锚点的问题。
what_is_inherited.en: It inherits the problem that curricula become stale across model updates and therefore require budget reallocation while retaining regression anchors.

material_change.zh: 父方案的观察式“边际学习进展+漂移”被替换为每轮真实随机预算干预得到的版本条件化因果 next-unit return，并要求在独立版本流中冻结迁移。
material_change.en: The parent's observational marginal-progress-plus-drift estimate is replaced by version-conditioned causal next-unit return identified from real randomized budget interventions, with mandatory frozen transfer to an independent version stream.

title.zh: 盲锚条件化纵向评价残差

problem.zh: actor 与 evaluator 都不断换版本时，新 evaluator 的评分偏差不仅是单一尺度偏移，还可能取决于它正在评价哪一代 actor，导致静态或逐 evaluator 校准错误排序未来候选策略。
problem.en: When both actors and evaluators change versions, a new evaluator's bias may depend on which actor generation it scores rather than being a single scale shift, causing static or per-evaluator calibration to mis-rank future policies.

changed_assumption.zh: 不再假设历史 actor×evaluator 交互能够在完全看不到新 evaluator 的情况下外推；每个未来 evaluator 都获得完全相同、极小且外部人工标注的盲 anchor panel，历史 crossed data 的价值仅允许体现在这些 anchor 之外的交互外推。
changed_assumption.en: The method no longer assumes that historical actor-by-evaluator interactions can extrapolate to a completely unobserved evaluator. Every future evaluator receives the same tiny externally labeled blind anchor panel, and crossed history may help only by extrapolating beyond those anchors.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在历史完整或近完整 actor-version×evaluator-version 评分矩阵上拟合分解 s(a,e,x)=b(x)+u_a(x)+v_e(x)+u_a(x)^T M v_e(x)，其中最后一项是必须保留的 actor-evaluator 交互残差。对新 evaluator e*，仅暴露 K 个预注册 anchor：每个 anchor 包含固定候选输出、e* 的评分和外部人工真值。用这些 K 个点估计 v_e* 的低维坐标，但冻结历史的 u、M 和基础评分头；随后用得到的交互项修正 e* 对未见 actor 策略的评分并进行策略选择。
exact_mechanism.en: Fit historical crossed actor-version by evaluator-version data with s(a,e,x)=b(x)+u_a(x)+v_e(x)+u_a(x)^T M v_e(x), where the final term is the required actor-evaluator interaction residual. For a future evaluator e*, expose only K preregistered blind anchors containing fixed candidate outputs, e* scores, and external human labels. Use those K points to infer the low-dimensional coordinate v_e* while freezing historical u, M, and the base scoring head. The resulting interaction term corrects e* scores for unseen actor policies before selection.

children.update_surface: frozen crossed actor-evaluator residual correction head

learning_signal.zh: 历史交叉版本评分、历史独立人工偏好标签，以及每个未来 evaluator 完全相同的 K 个盲 anchor 上的 evaluator-human 残差。
learning_signal.en: Historical crossed-version scores, independent historical human preference labels, and evaluator-human residuals on the identical K blind anchors for each future evaluator.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 由未参与模型拟合且不属于 anchor panel 的人工/专家偏好标签确定 double-held-out actor 候选的真实排序，并以最终所选策略相对人工最优策略的 selection regret 计分。
independent_ground_truth.en: Human or expert preference labels excluded from fitting and from the anchor panel determine the true ranking of double-held-out actor candidates, with policy-selection regret measured against the human-optimal candidate.

simplest_baseline.zh: 仅使用相同 K 个未来 evaluator anchor 拟合逐 evaluator affine 或 isotonic 校准，以及容量匹配的 SAJA/Bridge 风格轻量校准头，然后直接排序候选策略。
simplest_baseline.en: Per-evaluator affine or isotonic calibration and a capacity-matched SAJA/Bridge-style lightweight calibration head, each trained on exactly the same K future-evaluator anchors and then used for direct policy ranking.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造至少 4 个 actor 版本和 4 个 evaluator 版本的历史交叉矩阵，并将一个新 actor 版本和一个新 evaluator 版本同时完全留出。所有方法只能获得新 evaluator 上相同 K 个盲 anchor。随后让它们从 held-out actor 产生的多个候选策略中选择一个，并用未见人工标签计算 regret。逐步扫描 K=2,4,8；若 crossed interaction 在小 K 区间持续降低 double-held-out selection regret，而删除交互项后优势消失，则支持机制。
decisive_pilot.en: Build a crossed history with at least four actor and four evaluator versions, then hold out one new actor and one new evaluator simultaneously. Every method receives only the same K blind anchors from the new evaluator. Methods select among multiple policies produced by the held-out actor, and unseen human labels determine regret. Sweep K=2,4,8; the mechanism is supported only if the crossed interaction consistently reduces double-held-out selection regret in the low-anchor regime and the gain disappears when the interaction term is ablated.

stop_condition.zh: 如果相同 K 个 anchor 下，逐 evaluator affine/isotonic 或 SAJA/Bridge 校准达到相同 selection regret，或者历史交互项在 double-held-out actor×evaluator 上不提供增益，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if per-evaluator affine/isotonic or SAJA/Bridge calibration reaches the same selection regret with the same K anchors, or if historical interaction terms provide no gain on the double-held-out actor-by-evaluator pair.

what_is_inherited.zh: 继承 actor 与 evaluator 联合版本漂移会破坏未来策略排序，以及历史 crossed actor-evaluator 数据可能包含可迁移交互结构的假设。
